title: 第2770章 战况升级第2769章 不可入殿
content_zh:
生死城主手中凝聚着一轮生死太极图，杀意凛然，如同一柄即将出鞘的利剑。
生死殿主根本没空理会他，速度暴涨，朝着天殿全力冲去。
他心中只有那张奥义神座。
只要能得到它，他的生死神道便能更进一步，甚至有望打破神王桎梏，问鼎神尊之境。
到那时，区区生死城主，都不过是土鸡瓦狗罢了。
然而就在他踏入天殿百丈范围的刹那，悬浮在天殿深处的死亡天斧骤然暴动，斧光再现！
一道漆黑如墨的斧芒横贯长空，裹挟着生死天尊留下的死亡天道之力，朝着生死殿主当头劈落。
那股力量太过恐怖，简直像是真正的死亡天尊亲自出手，让整片虚无之地的生死规则都在这一斧之下剧烈颤抖。
生死殿主面色骤变，发冠在斧芒的冲击下炸裂开来，长发披散如魔。
他怒喝一声，右手猛然拍出，掌心之中生死太极图骤然浮现，与那道漆黑斧芒轰然碰撞。
轰！
两道至强力量猛烈撞击，爆发出惊天动地的巨响。
生死殿主的生死太极图在死亡天斧的至尊天道之力面前剧烈震颤，裂纹密布，却终究没有碎裂，硬生生将那道斧芒抵挡住了。
然而他的嘴角却溢出了一缕鲜血，身形微微后退半步。
他终究是硬扛了一击蕴含死亡天道之力的攻击，即便挡住了，也受了轻伤。
整条手臂在微微颤抖，显然那一击并不像表面上看起来那般轻松。
就在这一刻，身后一道身影如同鬼魅般袭至。
生死城主双手结印，一道巨大的生死太极图掌印轰然拍出，裹挟着四十万年的仇恨与怒火，直取生死殿主的后心。
“滚！”
生死殿主怒吼一声，反手一掌，同样是一道生死太极图轰然拍出。

两道掌印在虚空中猛烈碰撞，余波横扫千万里，将周围的虚无之地震得剧烈颤抖。
那一瞬间，整片虚无之地如同被一柄无形的巨锤狠狠砸中，虚空寸寸碎裂，漆黑的裂痕如同蛛网般向四面八方疯狂蔓延。
狂暴的余波裹挟着生死神王的毁灭之力，如同实质的海啸席卷而下，朝着下方观战的众人碾压而去。
“不好——”
有人失声惊呼，却已经来不及躲避。
冲在最前方的十几位半神修士首当其冲，被那股余波扫过的瞬间，身躯如同纸糊般寸寸崩碎，血肉炸开，化作漫天血雾消散，连惨叫都来不及发出。
他们手中的神兵法宝在神王级力量的冲击下如同朽木般碎裂，碎片四散飞溅，又将身旁修士贯穿。
“啊——”
惨叫声此起彼伏。
多位道法准神层次的存在拼命运转神力抵挡，却如同螳臂当车，护体神光如同薄纸般碎裂，身躯被余波震得四分五裂，残肢断臂飞溅长空。
有些人直接被震成齑粉，连一丝痕迹都未能留下。
即便是神灵也好不到哪里去，一个个神躯上布满密密麻麻的裂痕，嘴角溢血，气息萎靡到了极点。
唯有大神，以及古路六霸十二雄凭借绝对的实力，才能好上不少，但也显得相对狼狈。
短短三息间，观战者死伤过半，虚无之地残肢漂浮，血腥弥漫，幸存者望向两道至伟身影的目光中满是绝望与恐惧。
神王随手一击，便让下方众人如蝼蚁般灰飞烟灭。
幸亏不久前生死神山战场上，两大神王进入了特殊时空维度中斗法，否则后果不堪设想，他们也休想进入天尊道场内。
content_en:
A round of Tai Chi Diagram of Life and Death is condensed in the hands of the City Lord of Life and Death, with murderous intent, like a sharp sword about to be unsheathed.
The master of the Palace of Life and Death had no time to pay attention to him. His speed increased sharply and he rushed towards the Heavenly Palace with all his strength.
He only had the Mysterious God's throne in his heart.
As long as he can obtain it, his divine way of life and death can go a step further, and he may even be able to break the shackles of the God King and aspire to the realm of God.
At that time, all the city lords in life and death will be nothing more than chickens and dogs.
However, the moment he stepped into the 100-foot range of the Heavenly Palace, the death ax suspended in the depths of the Heavenly Palace suddenly rioted, and the ax light reappeared!
A jet-black ax beam crossed the sky, carrying the power of the heavenly law of death left behind by the Lord of Life and Death, and struck down towards the Lord of the Palace of Life and Death.
That power was so terrifying, it was as if the real Lord of Death had personally taken action, causing the entire rules of life and death in the land of nothingness to tremble violently under this axe.
The face of the master of the Palace of Life and Death suddenly changed, his hair crown exploded under the impact of the ax light, and his long hair was scattered like a demon.
He yelled angrily, and suddenly swung out his right hand. The Tai Chi diagram of life and death suddenly appeared in his palm, and collided with the dark axe.
boom!
The two powerful forces collided violently, erupting with an earth-shaking loud noise.
The Life and Death Tai Chi Diagram of the Master of the Life and Death Palace trembled violently in front of the supreme heavenly power of the Death Sky Axe, and was covered with cracks, but it did not break into pieces after all, and it blocked the axe's light.
However, a stream of blood overflowed from the corner of his mouth, and he took half a step back.
After all, he managed to withstand an attack that contained the power of death. Even though he blocked it, he was slightly injured.
The whole arm was shaking slightly, obviously the blow was not as easy as it looked on the surface.
At this moment, a figure came from behind like a ghost.
The Lord of the City of Life and Death formed a seal with his hands, and a huge palm print of the Tai Chi Diagram of Life and Death was suddenly shot out, carrying 400,000 years of hatred and anger, directly at the heart of the Lord of the City of Life and Death.
"Get out!"
The Master of the Life and Death Hall roared angrily, and with a backhand palm, the same Tai Chi Diagram of Life and Death was shot out.
The two palm prints collided violently in the void, and the aftermath swept thousands of miles away, shaking the surrounding void violently.
At that moment, the entire land of nothingness seemed to be hit hard by an invisible giant hammer. The void was shattered inch by inch, and dark cracks spread crazily in all directions like spider webs.
The violent aftermath carried the destructive power of the God King of Life and Death, sweeping down like a real tsunami and crushing the people watching the battle below.
"Not good——"
Someone exclaimed, but it was too late to escape.
The dozen or so demigod monks who rushed at the front were the first to bear the brunt. The moment they were swept by the aftermath, their bodies were shattered inch by inch like paper. Their flesh and blood exploded, turning into blood mist that filled the sky and dissipated. They didn't even have time to scream.
The magic weapons in their hands shattered like rotten wood under the impact of the god-king level power. The fragments scattered in all directions and penetrated the monks beside them.
"Ah——"
Screams came and went.
Several beings at the quasi-god level of Taoism desperately used their divine power to resist, but they were like mantises using their arms as chariots. The protective divine light shattered like tissue paper. Their bodies were torn apart by the aftermath, and their broken limbs flew into the sky.
Some people were directly shaken to pieces, without leaving even a trace.
Even the gods were not much better. Each god's body was covered with dense cracks, blood was bleeding from the corners of his mouth, and his breath was extremely weak.
Only the Great God and the Six Hegemons and Twelve Heroes of the Ancient Road can do much better with their absolute strength, but they still look relatively embarrassed.
In just three breaths, more than half of the spectators were killed or injured. The limbs were floating in the void, and blood was everywhere. The survivors looked at the two great figures with despair and fear in their eyes.
With a casual strike from the God King, everyone below was wiped out like ants.
Fortunately, not long ago, on the battlefield of the Holy Mountain of Life and Death, the two god kings entered a special dimension of time and space to fight. Otherwise, the consequences would be disastrous, and they would never even think of entering the Tianzun Dojo.
